class.name: HEGoInputNodes
class.brief_description: Turns the Godot nodes wired into a [HEGoNode3D] into HEGo input nodes.
class.description: Which input node a Godot node needs depends on its type: paths become curve inputs, meshes and CSG shapes become geometry inputs, a [HEGoGraphInput3D] becomes points and polyline primitives, and a Terrain3D becomes a heightfield input. The node path of the source is always sent along as [code]_hego_node_path[/code] so an HDA can tell its inputs apart.

method.name: resolve_paths
method.description: Expands input roots when settings.include_children is enabled. The stored paths remain compact; descendants are discovered again on every cook in scene order. Overlapping selections contribute each source once. Hidden authoring nodes are included, but this host's generated Outputs and CSG Boolean operands are not.

method.name: is_compatible_source
method.description: Whether a node supplies one of HEGo's supported input kinds. CSG assemblies bake from their root shape, including all of their Boolean children.

method.name: sync
method.description: Creates or updates the input node for the Godot node at [param input_node_path]. Pass the previous input node as [param existing_node] to reuse it when the source node still has the same type; pass null to always create a fresh one. Returns the input node to store, which is [param existing_node] itself when it was reused. [param settings] is the per-input settings dictionary from the input stash. curve_sample_length optionally controls Path3D upload spacing in metres. Missing, non-finite or non-positive values use the one-metre default.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
